articles.summary: FaZe Esports Earns $200,000 Championship Prize, Expected to Contribute to GameSquare's Fourth Quarter 2026 Revenue FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 17, 2026 / GameSquare Holdings, Inc. ("GameSquare" or the "Company") (NASDAQ:GAME), today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, FaZe Esports, won the Rainbow Six championship at the Osaka Major in Osaka, Japan, earning $200,000 in prize winnings, which is expected to contribute to GameSquare's fourth quarter 2026 revenue. FaZe Esports swept DarkZero 3-0 in the championship match to capture the Osaka Major title. The victory extends a historic run for FaZe Esports' Rainbow Six team, which previously captured the 2025 and 2026 Six Invitational championships and the 2026 Esports World Cup championship.
